Kolkata Metro, Bengaluru Traffic Adjusted for Muharram Observances

Kolkata Metro has announced reduced services on its Blue, Green, and Yellow lines for June 26 to accommodate Muharram observances. Concurrently, traffic diversions are in place in parts of Bengaluru for a Muharram procession on the same day. These adjustments reflect the impact of religious events on public transportation and city movement.
